how_to_apply: Apply only in the prescribed format (Appendix-A), downloadable from www.drdo.gov.in/drdo/careers.
Mention marks of qualifying exams as percentage; attach CGPA/CPI conversion document from the University.
Attach the listed documents in the given order.
Write 'Application for JRF' and the Degree/Branch/Discipline on top of the envelope.
Send by Post/Courier to Director, DEAL, DRDO, DEAL Campus, Raipur Road, Dehradun (Uttarakhand) – 248001.
Application must reach within 30 days from the advertisement publishing date in newspaper.
Make sure it reaches by 27 December 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DEAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 27 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DEAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 2 Junior Research Fellow (Computer Science engineering (CSE)), 1 Junior Research Fellow (Physics).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DEAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Appendix-A of this notice; downloadable from www.drdo.gov.in/drdo/careers) and send it to Director, Defence Electronics Applications Laboratory (DEAL), DRDO, DEAL Campus, Raipur Road, Dehradun (Uttarakhand) – 248001, by post/courier, to reach by 27 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 28 years (as on the absolute closing date). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 37,000 per month plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) as applicable for Junior Research Fellow (Computer Science engineering (CSE)), Rs. 37,000 per month plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) as applicable for Junior Research Fellow (Physics).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: CSE: First Division B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering with valid GATE (CS) score, or First Division M.Tech (CS) with specialization in Post Quantum Cryptography/Quantum Computing. Physics: First Division Master's in Quantum Physics/Electro optics/Photonics with valid NET/SLET/GATE score, or First Division B.E./B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering/Engineering Physics with valid GATE score (EC). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open to Indian nationals. Only candidates already awarded Degree / Provisional Certificates (B.Tech. or M.Tech.) are eligible. Marks of qualifying exams to be given as percentage; else AICTE prescribed formula will be used for CGPA/CPI. Candidates employed in Government departments/PSUs/Autonomous bodies must attach NOC with application.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Those who were already in JRF position/availed JRF/ RA/ Research fellowships in any government institute earlier.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting with respect to eligibility. Written test / interview or both. Shortlisted candidates w.r.t eligibility called for written / interview or both. Original certificates and a set of self-attested copies to be produced.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Completely temporary; maximum duration of 02 (two) years. Fellowship may terminate at end of second year, or be upgraded to SRF for third year through internal assessment. No right to absorption, regular/temporary employment or placement within DRDO.
